subject.why: The open notebook, red leather cover, yellow pencil, footprint sketch, and ribbon bookmark match the brief.

category.why: The tabletop is tilted diagonally and floating, revealing the background wall both above and below the surface.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The notebook is well centered with clear margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant palette with clear separation between the violet wall, warm wood, and notebook.

detail.why: Geometry remains chunky and free of excessive micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth 3D stylized volumes and soft satin materials align well with references.

bg_colour.why: background is purple (81% of the background); planned purple

fix: Level the tabletop into a stable horizontal surface so the purple wall sits entirely behind it rather than underneath.
